verdict.rationale: Document QnA combines OCR with an LLM so users can ask natural-language questions to extract information and insights from their documents, including multi-document comparisons. Annotations add AI-generated structured extraction and figure descriptions or captions. However, insights only come on demand through API calls the user writes. There is no evidence of proactive suggestions or recommendations, and only a passing playground link for in-product use. Missing for 10: proactive AI suggestions or recommendations, a documented in-product UI for generating insights beyond the API and playground link, and independent hands-on corroboration of the QnA insight quality.
